title: Integrated pharmacology and validation reveal Formononetin upregulates GSTM2 to modulate prostate cancer immune microenvironment via ROS/STAT3-driven chemokine reprogramming.
authors: Yu, Tianlun; Zhou, Yu; He, Fangkai; Wu, Yufan; Tang, Shiyun; Zhu, Zhouhan; Qian, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Formononetin通过GSTM2-ROS-STAT3轴调节前列腺癌免疫微环境，虽涉及分子对接但核心为药物靶点与肿瘤免疫，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Prostate cancer (PCa) is responsible for a substantial proportion of male cancer cases worldwide. Biochemical recurrence (BCR) representing a critical challenge in its disease management. Formononetin, a natural isoflavone derived from traditional Chinese medicine, has demonstrated potential anticancer properties. We sought to determine the translational potential of Formononetin-targeted molecules in PCa. METHODS: A list of putative targets of Formononetin were identified through five public databases. Overlapping candidates underwent further refinement using an ensemble of bioinformatics tools, encompassing differential expression profiling, co-expression network construction, and multiple machine-learning classifiers. Docked complexes and complementary analyses were subjected to evaluate the binding stability. To functionally validate GSTM2, we assessed its functional role on PCa cell growth, motility, and invasiveness in vitro, as well as the expression of CXCL10 and CCL22 chemokines. RESULTS: Integrative analysis identified 413 Formononetin targets, with overlapped 335 PCa-associated genes. Through weighted gene co-expression network analysis and differential expression analysis, 22 candidate genes were identified as Formononetin-related genes in PCa. Machine learning algorithms and survival analysis further suggested GSTM2 as the most important target. GSTM2 was positively correlated with enhanced immune infiltration and sensitivity to Bicalutamide. Single-cell analysis revealed that GSTM2-positive malignant cells exhibited upregulated glutathione metabolism and suppressed respiratory burst pathways. Stable complex formation between Formononetin and GSTM2 was demonstrated by computational docking. Cell-based assays demonstrated that Formononetin upregulated GSTM2 and inhibited PCa malignancy in a GSTM2-required manner. In terms of mechanism, Formononetin attenuated ROS levels and suppressed STAT3 phosphorylation via GSTM2, leading to reprogramming of chemokine expression characterized by upregulated CXCL10 and downregulated CCL22. CONCLUSION: Formononetin reprograms chemokine expression through the GSTM2-ROS-STAT3 axis to regulate the immune microenvironment, suggesting that it might have immune-modulating effects and is worth further in vivo studies.
abstract_zh: 背景：前列腺癌（PCa）在全球男性癌症病例中占相当比例。生化复发（BCR）是其疾病管理中的关键挑战。芒柄花素（Formononetin）是一种源自传统中药的天然异黄酮，已显示出潜在的抗癌特性。我们旨在确定芒柄花素靶向分子在前列腺癌中的转化潜力。方法：通过五个公共数据库识别出芒柄花素的推定靶点列表。重叠候选基因通过一系列生物信息学工具进行进一步筛选，包括差异表达谱分析、共表达网络构建和多种机器学习分类器。对接复合物及补充分析用于评估结合稳定性。为功能验证GSTM2，我们评估了其对PCa细胞生长、运动性和侵袭性的体外功能作用，以及CXCL10和CCL22趋化因子的表达。结果：整合分析识别出413个芒柄花素靶点，其中335个与PCa相关基因重叠。通过加权基因共表达网络分析和差异表达分析，22个候选基因被确定为PCa中芒柄花素相关基因。机器学习算法和生存分析进一步提示GSTM2为最重要靶点。GSTM2与增强的免疫浸润和对比卡鲁胺（Bicalutamide）的敏感性呈正相关。单细胞分析显示，GSTM2阳性恶性细胞表现出上调的谷胱甘肽代谢和抑制的呼吸爆发通路。计算对接证明了芒柄花素与GSTM2之间形成稳定复合物。基于细胞的实验表明，芒柄花素上调GSTM2并以GSTM2依赖方式抑制PCa恶性程度。机制上，芒柄花素通过GSTM2减弱ROS水平并抑制STAT3磷酸化，导致趋化因子表达重编程，其特征为CXCL10上调和CCL22下调。结论：芒柄花素通过GSTM2-ROS-STAT3轴重编程趋化因子表达以调节免疫微环境，提示其可能具有免疫调节作用，值得进一步进行体内研究。
